author: maui-sailfish
name: .NET MAUI App (with Sailfish OS)
description: The .NET MAUI app template (XAML, Shell, Resources, Platforms) with a Sailfish OS head: the same project builds for Android, iOS, Mac Catalyst, Windows and Sailfish OS (Qt/Silica host, harbour RPM). The Sailfish backend comes from the Microsoft.Maui.SailfishOS NuGet package. One-time machine setup: install the workload manifest (tools/sf workload-install) and add a NuGet source for the package feed. Use --sailfish-only on a machine without the MAUI workloads.

SailfishOnly.description: Only the Sailfish OS head (net11.0-sailfish) — no Android/iOS/Mac Catalyst/Windows heads, so no MAUI workloads are needed.
